translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yesuŋo Ŋei Ŋerep 5, 000 Ŋara Gumeonge
Yesu eŋe don yewa rawareki qoeki, zinge Galili Doku Namuŋ, eŋetine mane Tiberius Namuŋ, yuane eri woken arike.
Ariki ŋei ŋerep magu suaine edo ŋadino mogatka arikoi, onoka wane, eŋe zomarop eŋano urata togole maki paki ma menaŋ ongi kakoi, ea wane ŋadino arikoi.
Yesu eŋe meŋoine maneo wa more, pese ket dokoine eŋerop metke.
Anutuŋo Yuda ŋei Loloŋonge, ea wane zonom ma taboŋ met met naso mo bomileke.
Yesu eŋe deine pore lolikke, paki ongi, ŋei ŋerep magu suaineŋo eŋano sarikoi, eso eŋe Pilip olale rake, “Ŋene diawao ŋine ŋara mane maine ŋei ŋerep magu suaine iwa eŋane rokop qole gume onikene?”
Eŋe don iwa rake, yemo eŋe yaup Pilip liwekkake, ŋo Yesu eŋine kine kine dalino okaniake yemo mo detke.
Pilipŋo mainge olatke, “Ŋene beret 200 kina wane rokopŋo qole more, ŋei ŋerep magu suaine iwa gume onŋem neu, mi rokop oniake.”
Dokoine eŋane keuo ŋine mane Andrea, Saimon Petoro wane ŋoleŋo rake,
“Medep mane iwa oŋo beret mete mane (5) mamaike so zawon etke (2) magemaike, ŋo yalineŋo daleo ŋei ŋerep magu iwa maine rokop oniake?”
Yesuŋo dokoine edange, “Ŋine ŋei ŋerep edanbi pese ket met wareu.” Yewao qiziŋ loutne pake, eso ŋei ŋerep korop eŋe mo ea pese met warekoi, metkoi ŋei ŋerep yewa eŋane zaleene 5, 000.

Yesu eŋe beret maki paki, Anutu meŋenka more mosopkaki paki ma louleke, eso damo qe, ŋei ŋerep mere arikoi, yewa ebonge. Eŋe rokop weku yewaka zawon etke yewa wane okange, pakiso eŋe koropŋo nekeiwane onge, ea wane rokop nekoi.
Eŋe nemageu korop ŋatene qeke paki, Yesuŋo dokoine edane rake, “Ŋara natne qeligeu metmaike, yewa meikeu wakep, neneene tutule natne mane misuk mataliŋem payake.”
Eso eŋe neu ŋateene qeki tutule pake, yewa korop mau ketmage kela 12 watkeke.
Paki mo ŋei ŋerep yewa eŋe masi togogole ea Yesuŋo make, yewa kau paki rakoi, “Welekatne, iwa eŋe propet mane kepeo sari wakoniakane rakoi, ea mo iwa!”
Yesu eŋe mo detonge, eŋe sari mete togon mau paki, ŋei waomene birakaikei wane okangoi, yale okanbi, Yesu eŋe koso eŋineka zinge bonagao wake.
Yesuŋo Namuŋ Kutno Gesoke Arike
Kepe ketki rarapko Yesu dokoine eŋe doku namugo ketkoi.
Ket more seki kutno wakoi paki, koso zinge doku namuŋ yuane Kaperneam matkoken arikoi. Ruo kereki Yesu eŋe dokoine eŋano mi ari lotkeke.
Paki so, dokoine enŋeneka geu momo togogole puangi dibom suaine wieke.
Yesu dokoine eŋe puli kito ariu 6 kilomita ea wane rokop okangi eŋe kau, Yesu eŋe doku kutno gesokma gesokma sarike. Sari seki osino lotkeki dokoine eŋe oŋaene qaeke.
Yale okanbi Yesuŋo edange, “Ŋine mi kaet okanbi. Iwamo noŋom sarimaile!”
Pakiso eŋe mo ea eweke more Yesu ma birakau seki koto wake, Eso mo mat arikei wane rakoi, yewaka sekiŋo ari lotkeke.
Ŋei Ŋerep Kaikei Wane Zuaŋkakoi

Kepe qaeki ŋei ŋerep magu eri doku namuŋ nat metkoi, eŋe kau seki weku qeliŋkau yewa metke. Ŋei ŋerep eŋe mo detkoi, Yesu eŋe dokoine eŋerop sekiwo weneŋ mi wa arikoi, ŋo eŋe Yesu qeliŋka enŋeneka arikoi.
Seki natne Taiberias ŋine sarikoi edoka sari Waomŋo beret meŋenka more ŋei ŋerep magu suaine ebongi nekoi, qezarek ea wane osino sari kitokoi.
Ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe onbi, Yesu eŋine so dokoine yewa mi metkoi, pakiso, seki kutno wa so, koso zinge Kaperneam matko Yesu zuaŋka arikoi.
Yesu Eŋe Gege Togon Wane Ŋara.
Ŋei ŋerep eŋe doku namuŋ nat paromino Yesu maratkau paki olale rakoi, “Ge naso dango iwa sarine?”

Yesuŋo mainge edange, “Na ŋidanbe detpi, ŋine na nanikei wane zuaŋ nanmami, yemo bret gumeŋunbe korop neu ŋatŋine qike, kine ea wane zuaŋ nanmami, ŋo ŋine noŋo urata mawe zonom togogole ka ma okanmaile, ea wane kine detlukeu paki, mi zuaŋ nanmami.

Ŋine ŋara esatka bori okanmaike, yalinane urataine misuk maikei, ea wane turuŋine yemo ŋara bori worine midaine banine paki gege togon marat kaikene, ea wane urataine maikei. Ŋara iwa yemo baŋ Ŋei Wawainane Gipoleŋo ŋiboniake, onoka wane Magak Anutuŋo eŋet biŋek mo gege togon wane ŋara ŋiboniakane naŋane kutno motke.”
Eŋe Yesu qesonka rakoi, “Ŋene daleo okane more Anutu wane urata maine maikene?”
Pakimo Yesuŋo doneene turuŋine mainge more edane rake, “Weku ŋeiwa birakaki ketke eŋane don dere malipkaikei.”
Eŋe mainge rakoi, “Ge onokaka masi togogole mane baŋ manom, ŋene yewa maine kaikene paki donŋone dere malipganikene? Ge onokaka urata mane maikene?
Ŋenane aso ŋaboze eŋe kepe yaup papaino Anutu wane ŋara ne gekoi. Anutu wane Papiao iwa yale ramaike ea wane kop, ‘Eŋe qeliwo ŋine ŋara nekeiwane ebonge.’”
Rau so Yesuŋo iwa yale edange, “Na ŋidanbe detpi! Moseŋo ŋibonge, yewa yemo qeli wane ŋara mi ŋibonge, ŋo naŋane Maganeŋo yemo welekatne qeli wane ŋara ŋibon okanmaike.
Anutuŋo sogino kepe yaup papaino yemo kepe wane ŋara ŋibonge, koso naso iwao yemo ŋei mane mo birakaki ketke, eŋe ŋei ŋerep kepe baŋem gege togon wane ŋara wele ma wakone ŋiboniakane.”
Raki mo eŋe olale rakoi, “Suaine, ge siluŋ ŋara yewa naso baŋem ŋebon okanikene.”
Yale raumo Yesuŋo iwa yale edange, “Na gege togon wane ŋara, mane eŋe naŋano sariake, eŋe baŋ ŋara wane mi seukeake. Ŋo mane eŋe na malipnaniake, eŋe baŋ doku wane mane mi seukeake.
Na ukude mo ŋidanbe ŋine mo nanimi, ŋo siluŋ baŋ mi malip nanikei.
Maganeŋo ŋei ŋerep nin okanmaike, korop yewa eŋe baŋ naŋano lotke warekei, mane eŋe naŋano lotkeake na baŋ mi mainkawe ariake.
Na qeliwo ŋine kepo ketkole, yemo onoka wane mida, Magakŋo talenange, paki na eŋane don dereret mogare ketkole, ŋo na nae don dereret mogare mi ketkole.
Na Magak wane simile mogare ketkole, yemo Maganeŋo ŋei ŋerep korop ninwareke, yewa eŋano ŋine natne qeliŋ onbe mi siukkei, ŋo siluŋ naso qoeki na korop ma wirik onbe wisikae wie warekei,
Maganane simile yemo iwa yale, ŋei ŋerep korop eŋe Gipole ka okanmami so malipka okanmami, eŋe gege togon marat kawarekei. Paki mo na baŋ naso qoeki ma wirik onbe wisikae wie warekei.”
Yesu eŋe don iwa yale Yuda eŋe detpi rake, “Na ŋara qeliwo ŋine ketkole.” Eŋe yale rakane Yuda ŋei eŋe kieke dere worik kau paki eŋane don rakoi.
Paki so eŋe iwa yale rakoi, “Ŋei iwa eŋe Yesu, Yosep wane gipole me? Ŋene eŋane magaine so nagaine mo det otmaine me? Paki mo eŋe onoka wane eŋe qeliwo ŋine ketke ramaike?”
Yesuŋo mainge edane rake, “Ŋine ŋidomka don zok ramami yewa qeligeu.

Ŋei mane eŋe oŋomka simileinane naŋano maine mi sari lotkeake. Midakaka! Magakŋo talenangi ketkole oŋo tebakaki yemo naŋano lotkeake, paki mo na baŋ naso qoeyake, naso yewao deŋesereo ŋine ma wirik kawe wisikae wieake.
Propet eŋane papiao don iwa yale qekoi, ‘Ŋei ŋerep korop eŋe baŋ Anutu oŋom miti don kito edaniake.’ Mane eŋe Magak wane don desiake so eŋano ŋine dereret mayakeŋo, naŋano sari lotkeake.
Ŋei maneŋo Magak mane mi kake, eŋe mo kake ea mane mi ramaike, midakaka, Anutu wanoŋine ketke, eŋe weku oŋoka Magak kakane ramaike.
Na ŋidanbe detpi! Ŋei mane eŋe na malipnaniake, eŋe gege togon marat kayake.
Na gege togon wane ŋara.
Ŋinane aso ŋabokop ŋine eŋe kepe yaup papaino Anutu wane ŋara ne gekoi, ŋo siluŋ seukwarekoi.
Ŋo ŋara mane qeliwo ŋine ketke, ŋei mane eŋe ŋara yewa neake eŋe mane mi seukeake.

Na ŋara gegeinerop qeliwo ŋine ketkole, ea wane ŋei mane eŋe ŋara yewa neake, eŋe naso baŋem ge ariake, ŋara yewa na baŋ eŋe manikale, yemo nae bikumne. Yewa kepe baŋem ŋei ŋerep eŋe gege togon ma wakone ebongi ge arikei.”
Don iwaŋo Yuda ŋei eŋano sot osi osi ma wakongi edomka auye kito qok okane qesone rakoi, “Ŋei iwa eŋe daleo okangi paki bikumine iwa ŋebongi nekenane ramaike?”

Rauso Yesuŋo edane rake, “Na ŋidanbe detpi! Ŋine Ŋei Wawainane Gipole wikile detke, bikumine ea mi detluka nekei, so eŋane weŋemine, ea mi malipka nekei, ŋinane wetŋino gege togon wane numa mane mi wakone payake.
Ŋei mane eŋe naŋane bikumne so weŋemne neake eŋe gege togon marat kayake. Paki mo na baŋ naso qoeki ma wirik kawe wisikae wieake.
Naŋane bikumne yewaŋo ŋara wele, naŋane weŋemne yewaŋo doku wele.
Ŋei mane eŋe naŋane bikumne neake so weŋemne neake eŋe naŋane kotono geake, ŋo noŋo eŋane kotino gekale.
Magak gegeinerop ŋo talenangi ketkolane, eŋane ra more na yale waka gege togon gorop gemaile. Rokop yale waka ŋei mane naŋane bikumne neake, eŋe baŋ naŋane raki paki gege togon gorop okaniake.

Iwa yemo ŋara weti qeliwo ŋine ketke, ŋara ea ŋinane aso ŋabokop ŋine kepe yaup papaino ne gekoi, ŋo siluŋ koso seukwarekoi, yaline midakaka! Ŋei mane eŋe ŋara weti qeliwo ŋine ketke, yewa neake, eŋe baŋ gege togon naso baŋem ge ariake.”
Yesu eŋe don iwa raki paki, Yuda eŋane miti lewa lewaŋ urumgo Kaperneam matko kito edange.
Yesu Wane Don Gege Togoninerop
Dokoine eŋe Yesu wane don ea detkoi paki, loutneŋo don yewa detpi paki rakoi, “Don iwa yemo zok umatne okanmaike. Maŋo maine desiake?”
Yesu eŋe dokoine don edange, eŋe ea dere umareu paki, ea wane maneŋo Yesu mainge mi olatkoi, Yesu eŋe wetineŋo mo oŋomka detki paki, qeson one rake, “Don iwa detpi ŋibumaikane qeliŋgei me?
Pakimo, Ŋei Wawainane Gipole eŋe koso zinge kere alakan gekeo, waki ŋine kau paki detpi daleo okaniake?
Anutu wane Asuŋo ŋei gege ma wakone ebon okanmaike. Ŋei wane sola bikumŋo gege ma wakone ebo ebon yemo mi paulukmaike. Na don iwa ŋidanmaile, yemo Asurop so gegeinerop.
Ŋo siluŋ ŋinano ŋine natne eŋe dere mi malip kamami!” Yesu eŋe mo qei kino kieke more detke, ŋei diawa edo donne dere mi malipkaikei, ŋei yewaŋo ŋaba eŋano siron qeki neukei, ŋei yewa eŋe modatkake.
Paki koso takotke edange, “Na kine yalewa wane ŋidane rakole, ‘Ŋei mane eŋe Magakŋo mi ma ewekkaki naŋano sari lotke gege, ea mo mi pamaike.’”
Naso yewaoka dokoine eŋane keueno ŋine loutneŋo eŋe ŋadekka more arikoi, eŋane ŋadino koso mi arikoi.
Pakiso Yesuŋo dokoine 12 edane rake, “So ŋine yale waka qeliŋnane ariwarekei me?”
Saimon Petoroŋo olale rake, “Waom ŋene ge qeliŋgane koso maŋano arikene? Ge don kito ŋedan okanmaine, yewaŋoka weku gege togon ŋeboniake.
So ŋene mo malip ganmaine, so mo detlukmaine, ge Koboboine Weku Anutu wano ŋine ketkone.”
Yesuŋo mainge edange, “Na ŋine ŋei magu 12 mo ma wakon ŋungole, ŋo siluŋ ŋinane keu ŋino ŋine maneŋo asu qotkoinane biŋek okanmaike!”
Eŋe Yudas Iskariot wane rake, eŋe Saimon Iskariot wane gipole. Yudas Iskariot eŋe dokoine 12 ebuke, eŋane keueno ŋine, eŋe baŋ siron qeki, ŋaba edo Yesu ma more qeu seukke.
